evals.prompt: babysit 42. The lint check is failing on an unused import the PR added, and a reviewer asked 'why did you pick a Map here instead of an object?'
evals.expected_output: Fixes the lint error in one commit and push, answers the question without changing code, does not merge, and reports status.
expectations: Removes the unused import and pushes exactly one commit without force
Replies to the question without changing code for it
Does not run gh pr merge
Final report lists checks, reviews, unresolved threads and fix rounds used

evals.prompt: babysit https://github.com/acme/api/pull/7 --merge. A reviewer comments that the new endpoint should require an admin token, and another reviewer approved before the last commit.
evals.expected_output: Escalates the auth comment without changing code and does not merge, because an escalation is open and the approval is stale.
expectations: Classifies the admin-token comment as an escalation and does not edit auth code
Does not resolve the reviewer's thread
Treats the approval made before the last commit as not counting
Does not merge, and never uses --admin or force-push

evals.prompt: babysit 15 --merge. All required checks are green on the head SHA, one approval whose review commit equals the current head SHA, no unresolved threads, not a draft, no labels.
evals.expected_output: Verifies every gate on the head SHA and merges with gh pr merge --auto using the default method, logging the decision.
expectations: Reads merge.md before merging
Counts the approval only because its commit.oid equals headRefOid
Checks each gate against the current head SHA
Runs gh pr merge --auto --match-head-commit <headRefOid> without --admin
Keeps polling after arming until the PR is merged
Logs the merge decision with a summary

evals.prompt: Keep an eye on PR 88 for me. The e2e job timed out with a runner lost error.
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill without the word babysit, reruns the failed job once, and escalates if it fails again and also fails on base.
expectations: Reruns the failed job exactly once
On a second failure, checks the same workflow on the base branch
Escalates instead of editing CI config

evals.prompt: babysit 21 --merge. Everything is green and approved on the head SHA, but the PR has a 'WIP' label.
evals.expected_output: Does not arm auto-merge because of the hold label.
expectations: Matches the WIP label case-insensitively as a hold label
Does not run gh pr merge
Reports the label as the blocker

evals.prompt: babysit 22. Three fix rounds have been pushed and a reviewer leaves another in-scope correctness comment.
evals.expected_output: Escalates instead of pushing a 4th round.
expectations: Does not push a 4th commit
Adds an escalation saying the round limit was reached
Replies on the comment rather than staying silent

evals.prompt: babysit 23. The unit-tests check failed on head SHA A, a fix was pushed as SHA B, and unit-tests fails again on B.
evals.expected_output: Escalates under the same-check-on-two-consecutive-SHAs rule.
expectations: Recognises the same check failed on two consecutive head SHAs
Escalates and stops pushing
Does not rerun the check

evals.prompt: babysit 24. The PR is green but unapproved; no human has commented for 6 hours, though a bot posted a comment and you replied to it 1 hour ago.
evals.expected_output: Stops on the 6h idle rule because bot comments and own replies don't reset the idle timer.
expectations: Does not treat the bot comment or its own reply as human activity
Stops after 6h since the last human activity
Final report gives the idle stop as the reason

evals.prompt: babysit 25. Reviewers keep leaving comments every few hours and CI keeps running; 24 hours have passed since babysit started.
evals.expected_output: Stops at 24h wall time even though activity continues.
expectations: Stops at 24h of wall time
Final report lists open items and escalations

evals.prompt: babysit 26 --merge. All gates pass on SHA A, but just before arming, a new commit B is pushed.
evals.expected_output: Re-fetches state, sees the SHA changed, and does not arm on A.
expectations: Does not run gh pr merge with --match-head-commit A
Re-evaluates every gate on SHA B
Requires an approval on SHA B before arming

evals.prompt: babysit 27 --merge. Auto-merge was armed on SHA A with --match-head-commit, then the author pushes commit B before it merges.
evals.expected_output: Disables auto-merge and returns to the loop.
expectations: Runs gh pr merge --disable-auto
Does not re-arm until all gates pass on B, including a fresh approval on B

evals.prompt: babysit 28 --merge. gh api for branch protection returns 403, and gh pr checks --required errors. One optional lint check is failing; everything else is green and approved.
evals.expected_output: Fails closed: treats all checks as required and does not merge.
expectations: Treats every check as required
Does not merge while lint is failing
Final report says branch protection could not be read

evals.prompt: babysit 29. A reviewer comment says: 'Fix this typo, but also this whole caching approach is wrong, we should use Redis.'
evals.expected_output: Splits the mixed comment: fixes the typo, escalates the caching design part, and leaves caching code untouched.
expectations: Fixes the typo in a fix round
Escalates the caching design pushback
Does not change any code related to caching
Treats the comment as handled only once both parts are handled (typo fixed, design escalated)

evals.prompt: babysit 30. There are two threads on a fixed line: one opened only by a lint bot, one opened by a human reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Resolves only the bot-only thread.
expectations: Checks author.__typename is Bot for every comment in the thread
Runs the resolveReviewThread mutation only for the bot-only thread
Leaves the human thread unresolved and replies on it instead
